name: kelly-llm-gateway
description: Platform team's cost and model-governance dashboard over a shared LLM gateway: per-service/per-model call volume, cost, and error rate; a canary-rollout status board; and a deterministic cost/error anomaly list. Generic and brand-free — only role-based service names and generic provider/model labels. Human actions (promote/rollback/hold a rollout, acknowledge an anomaly) are written directly onto the route's own record — this app never changes a real routing config

agentPrompts: Summarize the latest Routes and flag what needs my attention.
Open Kelly LLM Gateway and show me the items that need review.
